title: Eyes
card: One brain gives every shape its own eye, from the page's pixels alone. When nothing moves, the brain rests and does no work.
tagline: One brain, an eye on every shape, and no work while nothing moves
kicker: IT WORKS ONLY WHEN SOMETHING MOVES
feature: One Cadence brain follows every shape with its own eye, from pixels alone. Its state holds what each eye saw, so a motionless scene costs it zero settling sweeps, like a resting animal. A network without state recomputes every frame.
howTo: Untick shapes move on their own: the brain's sweeps fall to zero. Drag a shape away: its eye jumps after it, and the brain works only for that move. Double-click a shape to give it an eye; click one to watch its eye in the brain.
